forcedChoices.reason: Here "actual" is the plain sense "the very, true"; the glossary form «en acto» is for the actual/potential contrast, which this sentence does not make.

Spanish has no single word for "evening"; «noche» fits a birth after dark and the Jewish day count.
"aggressive" here means bold and active, not hostile; «agresivo» would add hostility.
"bereaved" names the loss without saying of whom; «enlutada» keeps it open and does not add "of their father".
